scope.pasc_note: PASC is included as an evidence-reviewed six-component aggregate. Its calculations match R; named sensitivity ranges retain scientific uncertainty that is not represented as a confidence interval.
scope.population_model: Stable adult population with replacement into H

configuration.aging_of_mortality_and_life_expectancy_a: FALSE; adult-population-weighted values are held constant
configuration.long_covid_onset_formula: annual infection proportion * Long COVID risk per infection
configuration.reporting_unit: cumulative five-year DALYs per person and per 1,000 adults

pasc_components.label: Heart failure

pasc_components.range_reason: Stroke follow-up annualization and first-year/chronic mortality structure

pasc_derived_summaries.derivation: Sum of disability-weighted condition person-time divided by total condition person-time
pasc_derived_summaries.interpretation: Descriptive five-year baseline summary; not an operational model input

pasc_derived_summaries.parameter: Effective PASC mortality ratio relative to age-matched background mortality
pasc_derived_summaries.derivation: One plus condition-attributable deaths divided by expected background deaths during the same age-specific condition person-time
pasc_derived_summaries.interpretation: Descriptive five-year baseline effective ratio; not an operational model input or a pooled study hazard ratio

implementation_status.note: Six HEPA/Far UVC scenarios at 0%, 25%, 50%, 75%, and 100% implementation
0%, 5%, 10%, and 20% reductions in both disability weights
PI-specified sensitivity: 12.38% maximum population infection reduction at 0%, 25%, 50%, 75%, and 100% implementation

Returned Long COVID S2-to-S1 rate equals 0.10
Baseline Long COVID onset equals 0.2874 multiplied by 0.05
Acute and Long COVID sum to the primary combined total
Lower infection proportions correspond to lower primary DALYs
Primary output includes PASC and all-outcome total

compare_intervention baseline matches direct model run
compare_intervention intervention matches direct model run
compare_intervention DALYs averted match direct subtraction
Helper converts infection-conditioned onset for both runs
Lower infection produces lower effective Long COVID onset
Default Long COVID horizon is five years
Default Acute COVID horizon is five years
Default and explicit approved Long COVID settings agree
Default Long COVID calls scale onset with infection
Lower infection lowers default-call Long COVID DALYs
Named initial states are safely reordered

acute_covid.check: Model matches independent direct formula in all seven scenarios
Acute YLD uses the duration-weighted disability value exactly once
Adult-weighted remaining life expectancy is constant across five years
Stable versus closed population does not affect Acute COVID
Acute DALYs increase proportionally with infection proportion

pasc.check: Six component primary results are present
Baseline component sum equals PASC total
Lower infection proportions produce lower PASC DALYs
Every component decreases under the lowest infection scenario
All PASC outputs are finite and non-negative
Sensitivity endpoints surround each primary estimate
Derived weighted PASC summaries are finite and positive
Weighted PASC disability weight equals weighted person-time divided by person-time
Effective PASC mortality ratio equals one plus attributable over expected deaths
